what: The plugins a server may stop loading when it moves to this collection revision, because the revision takes them out. Deploy-DevGamemode.ps1 -LoadOrder -FromRecord lets the order of last-plugin.json leave out these and no other plugin the running server loads (Test-ThornswoodLoadOrderDrop, #2320), and only while revision is the one records/collection-plugins.json names. A row says why every form the plugin added can go from a world that keeps running.

dropped.name: atlas map markers.esp
dropped.why: Atlas Map Markers SE's page does not allow it in a collection (#3649, Patrick's B on q-3649-atlas). It is a light plugin of map markers, and the header read of 27 Oct found that no form a server stores moves when it goes, so main takes revision 6 with no wipe (#3649, comment 6435660887, Patrick's A on q-3649-rev6-wipe).
